openings.title: Data Analyst
openings.description:
We are looking for a Data Analyst to turn sales and inventory data into decisions.

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain dashboards for regional sales teams
- Write SQL queries to answer ad-hoc business questions
- Present findings to non-technical stakeholders

Requirements:
- 1+ years of experience in an analytics role
- Strong SQL
- Excel
- Tableau or Power BI
- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field or equivalent experience

Nice to have:
- Python for data analysis
- Statistics

openings.title: Backend Developer (Python)
openings.description:
Join the payments team building reliable APIs.

What you'll do:
- Design and build REST APIs for payment workflows
- Write tests and review code
- Improve performance of database queries

Requirements:
- 2+ years of professional backend development experience
- Python
- Django or FastAPI
- PostgreSQL
- REST API design
- Git

Preferred:
- Docker
- Redis
- AWS

openings.title: Frontend Engineer
openings.description:
Build fast, accessible interfaces for our design tools.

Responsibilities:
- Build reusable React components
- Work with designers to ship polished UI
- Keep pages fast and accessible

Requirements:
- 2+ years of frontend experience
- JavaScript
- TypeScript
- React
- HTML and CSS

Nice to have:
- Next.js
- Tailwind CSS
- Testing with Jest

openings.title: Machine Learning Engineer
openings.description:
Help us ship models that support clinicians.

What you will do:
- Train and evaluate machine learning models
- Deploy models to production and monitor them
- Work with data engineers on feature pipelines

Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience building ML systems
- Python
- PyTorch or TensorFlow
- scikit-learn
- Machine learning fundamentals
- SQL

Preferred:
- Docker
- MLOps experience
- AWS or GCP

openings.title: DevOps Engineer
openings.description:
Own our CI/CD and cloud infrastructure.

Responsibilities:
- Maintain CI/CD pipelines
- Manage Kubernetes clusters
- Automate infrastructure with Terraform

Requirements:
- 2+ years of DevOps or SRE experience
- Linux
- Docker
- Kubernetes
- Terraform
- AWS
- CI/CD

Nice to have:
- Python or Bash scripting
- Prometheus and Grafana

openings.title: QA Automation Engineer
openings.description:
Keep our releases reliable through test automation.

Responsibilities:
- Write automated UI and API tests
- Maintain the regression suite in CI
- Report and track defects

Requirements:
- 1+ years of QA automation experience
- Selenium or Playwright
- Python or Java
- API testing
- CI/CD

Preferred:
- Cypress
- Performance testing

openings.title: Data Engineer
openings.description:
Build the pipelines that move our shipment data.

- Model data in the warehouse
- Monitor data quality

Requirements:
- 2+ years of data engineering experience
- Python
- SQL
- Apache Spark
- Airflow
- dbt

Nice to have:
- Kafka
- AWS
